beats.text: "THE TABLE IS SET. THE VILLAGE IS ONE ANIMAL. IT IS VERY WELL FED AND IT WOULD LIKE TO HIT SOMETHING."
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibrat

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/7/3), 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
